messages.subject: Possible project idea - looking for mentors
parts:
Background: This project aims to teach machine learning interactively to beginners using a shiny web app.
Related work: 'swirl' package provides interactive learning for the Coursera Data Science Specialization by John Hopkins University.
Details: To build a package that includes a shiny app which provides an interactive teaching environment for the Andrew Ng course on Coursera.
Impact on the Community: Andrew Ng's course on Coursera is one of the most followed courses on Machine Learning. An interactive shiny based app will help the students to understand the course better.
